This smartphone UI screen is from an app called "Make Your Song." The main content of the screen includes:

1. **Title and Menu Bar**: At the top, there is a title "Make Your Song" with a menu button on the right.
2. **Main Section**: The main section is titled "Hodgepodge (A little bit of everything)".
3. **Icons for Music Tracks**: There are four icons representing different types of music tracks:
   - Drum Track (top left)
   - Guitar Track (top right)
   - Bass Track (bottom left)
   - Keyboard Track (bottom right)
4. **Central Mixing Icon**: In the center, there is a large icon with mixing sliders.
5. **Instructional Text**: Below the icons, there is a text instruction: "Click on each button to select a Drum Track, a Guitar Track, a Bass Track and Keyboard Track. Once all selected, Mix button is displayed."
